findings.title: per-request count query on every signed-in request has no index on projects.owner_id
findings.why: Line 205 runs `SELECT count(*)::int FROM projects WHERE owner_id = $1` for every signed-in request, before route dispatch, so it also runs for /api/me, 404s and the logout POST. db/001_schema.sql:17-25 defines `projects` with no index on `owner_id` (only the PK and the UNIQUE on `slug`), so each count is a sequential scan. The existing list query at server.js:264 scans the same way, and the fixture table is tiny, so nothing shows it is slow. Worth a `CREATE INDEX` on `projects(owner_id)` in a later migration, or computing the count only when `page()` renders a nav.

findings.title: Empty-state heading reads "Projects (0)" above "No projects yet"
findings.why: A user with no projects sees the heading "Projects (0)" and then "No projects yet". The ticket is silent on the zero case, and the spec's assumptions accept "Projects (0)", so this is consistent. It is slightly redundant copy, and a person may read "(0)" as a count they are meant to act on. Consider dropping the count when it is zero.

findings.title: Nav count is rendered inside the link text, so assistive tech reads it as part of the name
findings.why: The link reads "Projects · 1" to screen readers, which matches the ticket's wording. A visually hidden label such as "1 project" would be clearer for non-visual users. This is a taste call, not a defect.

findings.title: Empty-state link uses the default link colour, not the nav link colour
findings.why: "Create your first project" is rendered in the browser's default underlined link blue, while the nav links use the app's blue. The populated list's project link (e46, "Onboarding") uses the same default style, so this matches the existing in-content link pattern and is not a new inconsistency.
